ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: What is a predator of the earthworm?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This is a schematic diagram of a food web. Near the center there are earthworms labeled “EARTHWORMS,” and in the upper right there are birds labeled “BIRDS.” There is a red arrow in the figure pointing from the location of the earthworms toward the birds. Reasoning: In a food web, arrows usually indicate that energy flows from the organism being eaten to the predator, that is, from the food/prey to the consumer/predator. Therefore, the arrow pointing to the birds indicates that birds will prey on earthworms. Conclusion: One predator of earthworms is birds.
